reasons.plausibility: The proposed microstructural transformation under such extreme HPHT conditions is conceivable but has notable uncertainties regarding the formation of coherent interfaces.
reasons.testability: Tensile testing plus microstructural analysis (e.g., EBSD) under the stated conditions would clearly confirm or refute the predicted improvements in strength/ductility and interface coherence.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a distinctive method aimed at resolving a critical challenge in high-entropy alloy design, though the practicality of HPHT may limit widespread application.
